confirmed_implementation_findings: Upper control starts 2s total budget when it receives the opposite target, before zero SDO scheduling/acknowledgements.
BenchDrive accepted the ordinary zero targets but had not entered its separate reversing branch when the upper timeout latched.
Upper and lower control independently perform stopped confirmation. The host fixture reproduces two zero-write pairs and two three-sample waits.
Upper confirmation uses aggregate coherent_feedback_ms; lower confirmation uses independent left/right timestamps after zero acknowledgements. The freshness contracts are different.
T12 A/B do not call the controlled fault reset entry.
